column1: # IJSSOL claims ledger -- the referent for R-CAV (caveat propagation, check T2).
#   claim_id  tier  body_sites  derived_anchors  trigger  required_qualifier  forbidden_phrase  evidence
# derived_anchors: "~~"-separated VERBATIM anchor regexes, each of which must match exactly one
#                  paragraph of the main .tex. Anchoring on text rather than a line number keeps
#                  the ledger valid across every wave that moves lines. body_sites are informational.
# trigger:         regex saying "this claim is made in that paragraph". Empty = always enforce.
#                  The qualifier is demanded only where the trigger matches, so dropping a claim
#                  from a site is a legitimate fix; re-adding it unqualified is not.
# required:        regex that MUST match a triggered derived paragraph.
# forbidden:       "|"-separated regexes, none of which may appear in a derived paragraph.
# Tiers: assumed | designed | measured | observed | hypothesised-mechanism | recommended
